# deep >_ (deependhq.com)

> Sreedeep Surapaneni ("Deep") builds in public from Bangalore. Group CMO at Champions Group and CEO of Champions Accelerator. Twelve companies, one Obsidian vault. One log entry every weekday, written from the day's note and published nightly by an agent. Day 378, 156 entries since 2026-05-04.

Rebuilt 2026-11-13 20:00 UTC. Every number on the site is derived from one source file at build time. Team members are never named and clients in active deals are described by role, on purpose.

## Read
- [Home](https://deependhq.com/): the working window, 3 PM to 2 AM IST, and how a day becomes an entry
- [Mission Log](https://deependhq.com/journey.html): every weekday entry, newest first, with arcs and dates
- [Writing](https://deependhq.com/writing.html): the weekly narratives, one essay a week written from the log
- [Pillars](https://deependhq.com/pillars.html): the four pillars of Champions Group and the companies in each
- [Stack](https://deependhq.com/toolkit.html): tools built, used, tried and watched, dated by their last mention in the log
- [Now](https://deependhq.com/now.html): what has attention right now

## Built here
- [ChampBeam](https://champbeam.com): Smart links, QR codes and file tracking in one product. Send it, know they saw it. ChampUTM lives inside it now. (live at champbeam.com)
- [Event Scout](https://event-scout-delta.vercel.app): Mobile PWA for event contact capture. Business card scanner plus AI chat. (live at event-scout-delta.vercel.app)
- [ChamPDF](https://champdf.com): Free PDF tools that run in the browser: merge, split, compress, convert. No signup. Started as extraction for the... (live at champdf.com)
- [ChampHarbinger](https://champharbinger.vercel.app): Find buying signals in hiring, funding and company news. Research accounts, enrich contacts and draft outreach in a... (live at champharbinger.vercel.app)
- [LakeStream](https://github.com/Champ-Deep/LakeStream): Template-based web scraper for B2B data enrichment. YouTube transcripts included. (internal, runs in-house)
- Deep Scanner: Internal local-file safety scanner. Flags secrets and sensitive text before cloud sync; not a prospecting or... (internal, runs in-house)
- [ChampUTM](https://github.com/Champ-Deep/ChampUTM): UTM link builder and tracker. React/Vite. Open source.
- [ChampMail](https://github.com/Champ-Deep/ChampMail): email outreach automation. human-cadence sending, self-hosted Stalwart SMTP. live and scaling.
- [ChampGraph](https://github.com/Champ-Deep/Graphiti-knowledge-graph): Knowledge graph per prospect. Neo4j/FalkorDB. The brain behind the AI SDR.
- [ChampQuest](https://github.com/Champ-Deep/ChampQuest): Rewarding task tracking for teams. Now being reborn as a ranch scavenger JRPG.
- [B2B Pulse](https://github.com/Champ-Deep/B2B-Pulse): LinkedIn and Meta engagement automator. Powers the 5 PM IST daily social triage.
- [deependhq-site](https://github.com/Champ-Deep/deependhq-site): This site. No-build React on Cloudflare Pages. Auto-updates daily from the vault.

## Machine-readable
- [llms-full.txt](https://deependhq.com/llms-full.txt): every journey entry and essay as plain markdown
- [data.js](https://deependhq.com/data.js): the whole site as one object, window.DH_DATA, rebuilt nightly around 01:00 IST
- [feed.xml](https://deependhq.com/feed.xml): RSS for the weekly narratives
- [sitemap.xml](https://deependhq.com/sitemap.xml)
